lessons.summary: A canonical URL tells search engines which URL is the preferred version of a page.
lessons.objective: Add a canonical link in head that points to an absolute http or https URL.
lessons.hint: Put <link rel="canonical" href="..."> inside head.
lessons.commonMistake: Focus on the semantic element and the required attributes first. Your visible text can be personal unless the task asks for exact machine-readable values such as ids, URLs, names, or dates.
lessons.bestPractice: Build the smallest valid HTML that proves the metadata idea first, then personalize visible text once the semantic structure is correct.
lessons.code:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>CodeTrail</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/styles.css">
</head>
<body>

</body>
</html>

lessons.title: Load scripts without blocking
lessons.summary: defer avoids blocking HTML parsing for classic scripts. Module scripts defer automatically. noscript explains what happens without scripting.
lessons.objective: In head, load one deferred classic script and one module script. In body, add noscript fallback text.
lessons.hint: Put both script tags in head and noscript in body.
lessons.commonMistake: Focus on the semantic element and the required attributes first. Your visible text can be personal unless the task asks for exact machine-readable values such as ids, URLs, names, or dates.
lessons.bestPractice: Build the smallest valid HTML that proves the scripts idea first, then personalize visible text once the semantic structure is correct.

lessons.title: Assemble an accessible page
lessons.summary: A production page combines semantic structure, accessible navigation, meaningful content, metadata, and usable forms.
lessons.objective: Build a complete page body with a skip link, header/nav, main article, labelled signup form, and footer.
lessons.hint: Choose an id for main, point the skip link to that id, and nest the article and form inside main.
